| **I$Detach** | Detach device | (a2)=entry | - | At zero use count, calls TERM and frees storage unless shared. Superuser only |
| **I$Open** | Open path | d0.b=mode - a **bit field** `D S E W R`, so **0 requests no access** and reads then fail on a successfully opened path (see `common/unix-differences.md`; POSIX `O_RDONLY` is 0), (a0)=pathname | d0.w=path number, (a0)=updated past the pathname - to the first blank after it (`Live` (os9exec): `'fx   '` opens `fx` and returns a0 at name+2); trailing spaces are not stepped over | Allocates a path descriptor
